items.note: Parameters h, v, N, I, both constructions' copy/gather/scatter/side-injection maps, the eight-row schedule, the net change (JV+RG)x, the central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2, the three-stage composition (x,y)->(-y,x) and the wire counts W_b, W_c all match lines 653-783. The S2.1 headline loosely calls all three stages forward invocations, but S2.1.7 states the inverse middle stage correctly.

The plan gives the paper's invariant proof: the logical array is D_in^{-1} f, the stored array is D_v applied to it, edges apply D_v D_u^{-1}, and a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate. That yields D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each route applies eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, as at lines 804-825.

Every part of the paper's derivation is reproduced and agrees with the paper: the bilinear forms, terminal labels, interstage transitions, the eight gate labels (eq:motif-labels), the full residual table with the same dimensions, the single decreasing edge (centre 3->4, loss h), the telescoping that gives Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The parenthetical justification in S2.3.3.6 is loose (see errors).

The plan assigns P_U to gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} to sources. It shows rank(P_V-P_U) = dim V - dim U, and it notes that the N first X_a edges are rank-one exceptions (matrix 2P_{U_a}). It reaches s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b < W_b m and the endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m, exactly as in the proof at 1156-1172.

Follows the proof step by step: additivity of weight mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, odd weight of unit vectors, the identity H diag(1,-1) H = X giving aI+bX_v, the sum s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, the special X_a->Y_a pair with wt(u)=27 fixed by Z and i^{27k}, then negation and undoing rho to get C^{tensor m} (and mk columns).

From L/N<1/2 the plan gets the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, then the exact eta_b and eta_c, then eta > 20*2^-50 and log m < 20. This gives m^{1-2^-50} > m(1-eta), hence s/W < m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50, as at lines 1319-1343.

All the operations are stated with O(V) cost. Two conditions are left out: that W divides R for the V/W volume and the merge, and that the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time (that one appears only in the quote). S1.2 gives the split-at-Q-a mechanism for shifts. The elementary-stream proof (q^2-way digit split, r=Wg+w) and the unit-scaling construction are not derived, so I chose the conservative verdict stated rather than a partial derivation.

Includes the elimination proof of A=E_1 Pi E_2 (topmost row, rightmost pivot), the choice of a fixed odd prime, triangular transforms in descending order by controlled shifts, the conjugation order, and the three-step realisation of H_i += D_j with one interchange. The result is exactly a interchanges plus O(V).

Every step matches lines 1491-1615: the row split r=Wg+(w-1) into W streams of volume V/W, the Phi_M frames that give Phi_{I_m} on every role, the three-shear interchange, s recursive calls, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum giving O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape parking schedule and descriptor accounting.

Matches the proof: k and rho, the four field orders, the row field R=q^{2rho} >= W^k padded to R' < 2R, the base-m pieces with cost O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau} = O(V e^tau), binary-to-radix-q padding, and the one-bit-difference case.

Gives the basic identities for C, the conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1} = X_{Mv}, and the edge identity in coordinate directions. It includes the slot/column layout with one child per residual direction, the inverse-child formula, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, s_c children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{tensor D} = b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D.

Covers the eight-operation gadget, cyclic shifts on f-1 segments, guard interval 10..2^{K-1}-11, delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^-K}, the fact that T_0 S_0^{-1} permutes only B, repair by extraction and radix sort, the cost terms and their o(1) normalisation, and the change-of-basis application. It leaves out the final two-bit XOR at j_{f-1} (lines 2054, 2187-2193), a small completion step, which is why I counted it as faithful.

Gives the leaf kernels O(Ve), the node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0, k_0 and the row padding to a multiple of W^{k_0}, role streams of volume V/W, and the recurrence with cutoff d^beta. It then bounds internal costs by O(e^lambda) via K <= e^{c/beta} and leaves by O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), and gets O(d^{lambda'}) from the base-m pieces, all as at 2393-2445.

The parameter setting, guard constants (E, B, nu=11, C_1=20, C_0=128mB^2), depth recurrence A(e) <= sA(e/m)+E, the bound below C_0 d^{C_1}, the representation by p+Delta and Delta+3 bits, epsilon*C_1 < 1 giving Delta=o(p), and the final error < sqrt2 2^-p from absolute row sums all match the paper.

Covers character cancellation through the absence of two-torsion, DIF butterflies, bit-reversed storage with B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, the layout L (D(b+1) prefix slots, at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges giving pK^{tau-1}), offset (h-b) mod K, per-round layer calls, monomial shifts, J_E Q_p = Q_p J_E, and error sqrt2 l 2^-p.

B_0=2^{4p}, the separation bound |h_j| <= r2^{2p} < B_0/2, the signed packing carries in {-1,0}, centred extraction with carries in {0,1}, negacyclic reduction and the four products giving O(rp log(rp)) all agree with the proof.

Covers the normalisation identity M F^+((F^-f)(F^-g)/r) = f*g/(rM), the commutation P(LBu,LBv) = LB P(u,v), the error chain 2delta, +eta, +delta, times M giving sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^-p, and the cost with log(rp), as in the proof.

Covers the Gaussian maps S and T, the identity T P_s F_s = P_t F_t S, the Neumann inverse of N = C T D, normalisations multiplying to 2^{-2 alpha^2}, A=S' and B_0=D'J'C, the error and time table, ordered selection C, the tensor identity with gamma=2d alpha^2, linewise error dp^2, and axis exposure O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)).

Covers the chirp periodicity, the coefficient check giving Q F_t, the dilation identity F^+ R_c = R_c^{-1} F^+ with t_i a unit mod s_i, and the two normalisations giving (u*v)/S^2, as in the proof at 3938-3987.

Every element is present and correct: the fixed rationals including kappa=2^-182, the size choices and comparison constants, alpha, gamma, eta=1/(4d), the prime-interval lemma giving distinct odd primes, T/2 < S < T by Bernoulli, alpha^4 theta_i > p, the n^{o(1)} prime search, and the no-wraparound and capacity bounds.

Covers the isomorphism argument, the triangular formula b_i = a_i + mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j mod s_i, updates in the order d..1, rotations of the valid interval that preserve the padding, prefix-controlled shifts, and axis reversal by O(d^2) chunk swaps giving O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)).

Covers Theta: x_d -> zeta y as a well-defined isometric isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h = zeta^j, M_C = D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g) = (f*g)/T, the computed twist sequence, and twist errors below 4 each (S6.2).

Covers the chirp transform sequence, the exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A = R F_s, the conjugated opposite procedure, the digit scaling 2^{-b-2}, and the six numbered operations. It also explains why the two scales by S undo (u*v)/S^2. The S4.5 formula writes the exact A and B_0 in place of their linewise approximations (see errors).

The error chain E_ring < 5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s = 9*2^gamma TL, (2E_s+2), (3E_s+2), E_w < 28*2^gamma T^2 L and the final 448b 2^{-3b/4} < 1/2 match the paper, together with the disk margins, rounding and the carry invariant.

Reproduces the cost table and powers, the margins g_1..g_7 with min = 2^-181 = 2 kappa from the chunk-exchange row, the derivation of each row, the o(V) setup and exceptional-sorting bounds, absorption of fixed powers of log p, and the schoolbook cutoff.

S0 asserts that the bound disproves the n log n optimality conjecture in this model. No step gives the content: an eventual lower bound c_A n lg n for every machine, its negation via liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n) = 0, or that the bound gives limit zero.

errors.says: Three stages of forward invocations y_S -> y_S + x_S send (X_a,Y_a) -> (-Y_a,X_a).
errors.paper: Stage 2 is not a forward invocation from X to Y. It is the inverse forward schedule from Y to X, which effects X <- X - Y; only stages 1 and 3 are forward X-to-Y invocations. The plan's own S2.1.7 states this correctly.

errors.says: Over F_2 every nonzero residual is nonalternating because it contains a norm-one coordinate vector outside the supports of the earlier tensor vectors.
errors.paper: Coordinate units are used only for B, Q^perp, triple complements and full spaces. In the lines P, Q and <t> the norm-one vectors are the tensor indicators themselves, and the chosen vectors are tensored. A residual such as P (x) <t_Y> (x) Q contains no coordinate vector, so the stated reason is not the paper's and is false for some residuals. The conclusion is right.

errors.says: Splitting whole rows cyclically into W streams of volume V/W (and merging them) takes O(V).
errors.paper: The split is defined for any row count, but equal shapes, volume V/W and the merge in any fixed order require W to divide R.

errors.says: Method: eight whole-chunk cyclic shifts implement the XORs correctly away from a small exceptional set, followed by the repair.
errors.paper: The shifts and the repair handle only positions j_0..j_{f-2}. The most significant selected position j_{f-1} is omitted at first and supplied at the end by a separate two-bit XOR (Lemma elementary-streams). The plan never mentions that step.

errors.says: The computed source transform is F~ = 2^gamma B_0 C~ A, with the exact maps A and B_0.
errors.paper: The procedure applies the linewise approximations A~ and B~_0 around the computed chirp transform. Only its exact counterpart is 2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route all the way to the main bound. S2 builds the scratch-restoring exchange network, frames, nested labels and the rank budget, then the strict saving s<Wm and tau=1-2^-50, the Bruhat-type shear, and the power-width and arbitrary-width interchange. It then builds the complex layer recursion with packed basis changes and guard bits, and S3-S7 assemble the synthetic transforms, ring convolution, resampling, chirp and permutation cancellation, the six-step algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table with minimum margin 2^-181 = 2 kappa. The tree is thin in three places: the stream primitives are only stated, the last selected bit of the packed addition is not shown, and the disproof of the conjecture is asserted in S0 without the liminf argument.

steps.note: Includes h=100, v=C(100,3), N=v^3, m=h^3, banks X_a, Y_a indexed by triples, and the three-stage scratch-restoring schedule sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) with every auxiliary wire restored.
One frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge costs only the change D_v D_u^{-1}; S2.2's motivation states the cheap-edge role.

Gates get nondegenerate subspaces of F^{tensor 3} (dimension m) built from triple indicators, and every edge joins comparable labels. The only decreasing edges are the central 3->4 edges, each losing P (x) F of dimension h.
P_V - P_U has rank dim V - dim U for nested nondegenerate U in V. The N first X_a edges, with matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one, are the exceptions.
The signed changes sum to Wm-2N and the absolute changes to Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich. Adding the N source ranks gives s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b.
L_b/N = 100/539 and L_c/N = 101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b > 0 and 2N-2L_c > 0 give s < Wm.
M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp} + P_{U_a} = I_m for X_a, 0 to I otherwise), so with frames Phi_M the bit network applies H <- H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 with triangular parts by controlled shifts, exactly a interchanges plus O(V). Each interchange is a recursive call, so a node makes s calls in all.
Children have volume V/W, so F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1} + O(1). From eta > 20*2^-50 and log m < 20 the plan gets s/W < m^tau with tau = 1-2^-50, then the geometric sum and F_k = O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining content and in the role they play: the fixed scratch-restoring bank exchange, frames, nested labels with the single decreasing central edge, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity giving the shear, the rank-a shear as a recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^-50.
